verdict.rationale: Intel documents first-party developer tooling aimed at this generation: oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra series 2, VTune Profiler analysis features, and a DPC++/SYCL migration tool. The spec sheet lists supported AI frameworks (OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN). Mature general-purpose compiler support and tier-one OS treatment are only thinly evidenced: a community report describes Arrow Lake's 'messy launch on Windows' needing fixes from Intel, Microsoft and motherboard makers. Missing for 10: documented compiler support and tuning (GCC, LLVM, ICX flags or targets), a published architecture optimization manual, explicit tier-one Linux or Windows support statements, and independent corroboration of developer-tooling maturity.

support.subject: As a developer, this architecture is a first-class development target — mature compilers, official optimization guidance, and an OS and tooling ecosystem that treats it as tier one
